meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: Claude 会在跑计算任务前运行检测脚本，读出 CPU 核数、GPU（NVIDIA/AMD/Apple Silicon）、内存、磁盘与系统信息，在当前目录生成 .claude_resources.json，并附并行、内存、GPU 与大数据处理的建议。
howto.when: 在你开始计算量大的任务时接管，例如分析大数据集、训练模型、并行处理大量文件之前。

say.text: 先检测这台机器有哪些可用资源
我有 50GB 数据要分析，先看看资源和处理方案
say.note: 据此判断是否需要 Dask/Zarr

say.text: 训练前查一下有没有可用 GPU 和后端
say.note: 报告 GPU 类型与可用后端

howto.what_en: Claude runs a detection script before compute-heavy work, reporting CPU cores, GPU, memory, disk and OS, writing .claude_resources.json in the working directory plus parallel, memory, GPU and large-data suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local task, such as analyzing large datasets, training models, or parallel processing.

say_en.text: Check what resources this machine has first
I have a 50GB dataset - see what resources and approach fit
Check for available GPUs and backends before training
say_en.note: Reports GPU type and usable backends
